page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C processor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed offer a robust compute profile relative to its standard memory footprint, making it a stable choice for workloads requiring consistent processing power without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated high-frequency Intel Xeon processor, the ecs.hfg8i.4xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads, web serving, application servers, and medium-scale database hosting where network-attached storage is utilized.
